summary: A single-open Accordion with its open item bound to state and the current value printed below.
use: FAQ or settings sections where the app needs to read or set which item is open.
spec: State: `let value = $state<string | string[] | undefined>('c1')` opens the first item initially
2 items: `<AccordionItem value="c1" title="First section">` and `<AccordionItem value="c2" title="Second section">`
`Open item: {Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(', ') : (value ?? 'none')}` prints the bound value
